_doc: The ten reference cameras (tools/refcams/README.md). eye = TRUE world x,y,z,yaw,pitch (yaw 0 looks north, 90 west; pitch degrees up); agl true = y is metres over the plan's ground there. weather is a Weather.STATE_KEYS name. Change a camera only on purpose: every run before the change stops being comparable for that shot. Wave 5 (refcam2 sessions): one row per new camera, on its own line; optional staging keys: air (AirTraffic.stage kind: taxi|pushback|apron|final...), air_dist, air_side, as still_shot.gd's AIR / AIR_DIST / AIR_SIDE; street_cars {axis, at, cars: [[along, dir, lane, speed], ...]} (TrafficManager.place_car(), refcams_shot.gd).
